app.title: Life Timeline
app.tagline: Map the moments that shaped your story.

disclaimer.title: A tool for self-reflection, not therapy
disclaimer.body: Revisiting difficult memories can be painful. Go at your own pace, add only what you feel comfortable with, and take breaks. If you are dealing with trauma or feel overwhelmed, please reach out to a mental health professional.

home.heading: Welcome
home.intro: A Life Timeline places the important events of your life along a line, from birth to today. Marking the highs and lows helps you notice turning points, strengths and themes in your own story.
home.savedHint: These are stored only in this browser, on this device.
home.empty: No timelines yet. Create one, or open a .tl file you exported before.
home.deleteBody: “{{title}}” will be removed from this browser. This can’t be undone. If you might want it later, export it as a .tl file first.

errors.required: Please enter at least the year.
errors.invalid: This date doesn’t look right. Check the year (1850–2200) and day.

timelineForm.title: Title
timelineForm.titleRequired: Please give your timeline a title.
timelineForm.name: Name (optional)
timelineForm.nameHint: Whose story is this? You can leave it blank.

privacy.title: Your privacy
privacy.lead: We never receive or store your timeline. This app is just a set of tools that runs in your browser.

points.localOnly: Your timeline is saved only in this browser, on this device. It is never sent to us or anyone else.
points.canBeLost: Clearing your browser data, using private/incognito mode, or switching to another browser or device means it won’t be there.
points.backup: To keep a backup or continue on another device, use Export → .tl file, then Open .tl file to load it again.
points.filesAreSensitive: Files you export (.tl, PDF, PNG) contain your personal story. Keep them somewhere safe.

privacy.acknowledge: I understand that my timeline is stored only in this browser and that I’m responsible for exporting a backup.

how.noServer: There is no server or account. The app is a static website and all work happens on your device.
how.blocked: The app tells your browser to block any attempt to send data over the network.
how.exports: Exports are created on your device and downloaded directly. Nothing is uploaded.

eventForm.gentleHint: Only the title and the year are needed. Add as much or as little detail as feels right.
eventForm.title: What happened?
eventForm.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Moved to a new city
eventForm.hasEnd: This lasted for a period of time
eventForm.symbolHint: Optional. Flowers and stones come from the lifeline exercise used in therapy.
eventForm.descriptionPlaceholder: What do you remember about it?
eventForm.reflectionPlaceholder: Looking back, what did it teach you? What helped you get through it?

symbols.flower: Flower: a positive moment or person
symbols.stone: Stone: a painful or traumatic moment
symbols.star: Star: an achievement or proud moment
